text:
No option can be put forward from this run because the monthly churn limit was not checkable in the model.

- The comparison is otherwise marked robust under the tested variations, but it answers only the modelled MRR outcome—not whether churn stays strictly below 4%.
- The strongest structural driver is the Pro subscriber base; its value is an Olumi estimate, not user-provided evidence. New Pro sign-ups and monthly churn are also estimated inputs.
- The model also assumed that more MRR is the intended direction, rather than checking progress against the £20k target as a level.
